text: The user ran `claude plugin marketplace add ~/git/yolo-twice/` to register the local repo as a plugin marketplace, but it was already declared in user settings from earlier testing, so nothing changed. `claude plugin list` confirmed `yolo-twice@yolo-twice` v0.1.2 is enabled at user scope and reads live from `code/plugin`, so edits there reach new sessions without reinstalling. The plugin's command is `/yolo-twice:yolo-twice`.
